pixel_description: Render-only: bright stairwell with light wood stairs on right, white wall. Center is stair trolley leaning diagonal. Two parallel silver twin spine tubes run from bottom bracket up to top U-loop handle with black grip on left side. Black brake deadman lever clamped under handle on left tube with black coiled cable running down left side to lower mechanism. Mid-spine is silver fold hinge lock bracket with pivots and lock lever joining upper and lower tubes. Bottom of spine clamps to tri-star mechanism and to silver toe plate. Toe plate is flat rectangular platform angled on steps supporting large cardboard parcel strapped with dark webbing cross straps with buckle. Under toe plate are two small swivel caster wheels bearing on stair treads. Critical part p_star tri-star wheel cluster: drawn at lower end of spine on lower stair nosing as central toothed hub with three radial metal arms at ~120 deg, each arm ending in small black solid-tyre wheel; bottom wheel contacts lower nosing, second wheel forward-right visible, third arm/wheel partially occluded behind bracket/brake band but star geometry evident; partially encircled by thin curved brake band/pawl ring connected to cable; forward bracket connects cluster to toe plate frame. Left side leaning against wall is folded flat slab with wheels at bottom showing stowed configuration.

deviations.measured: pixels show central toothed hub with 3 radial arms each ending in small black wheel on stair nosing, segmenter missed label due to overlap with brake band
deviations.expected: tri-star wheel cluster detectable as 'wheel cluster' with 3 wheels on orbit
deviations.why: viewpoint and brake band overlap confuse segmenter but 3-arm orbit geometry is visibly present and bears on nosing as designed

deviations.measured: pixels show 2 parallel silver tubes from loop handle to lower bracket, joined to toe/star bracket at base; apparent gap is segmentation/occlusion
deviations.expected: 1 visible spine and touching toe plate
deviations.why: twin tubes qty 2 is design intent; connection to toe is via metal bracket visible at base, so 2-count and apart flag is not a working-principle change

deviations.measured: pixels show main toe plate under parcel joined to spine/star bracket plus second toe appearance as part of folded slab leaning on left wall
deviations.why: second detection is intentional folded-slab view per figure_spec unfolded plus folded slab, not a duplicated part; main toe is connected

deviations.measured: pixels show black deadman lever mounted directly under loop handle with coiled cable running down spine to star brake
deviations.why: design connection handle to brake is via cable, so physical separation along cable is expected and does not break fail-safe function

deviations.measured: pixels show transverse U-loop at top with horizontal grip, diagonal spine, lever clamped to handle; loop size ~0.38x spine
deviations.expected: vertical long axis handle ~0.83x spine and touching brake
deviations.why: horizontal is correct for loop grip across top; small size is loop only not full handle length; cable provides brake connection

deviations.measured: pixels show 2 webbing legs crossing over parcel on inclined toe with buckle, anchored to toe, tilted ~124 deg, ~0.64x toe
deviations.why: 2 detections are 2 legs of one two-point harness assembly; tilt and smaller projected length follow inclined toe/parcel perspective, retention function unchanged

deviations.measured: pixels show mid-spine silver bracket with side plates, pivots and lock lever joining upper/lower tubes with cable guide
deviations.why: segmenter missed label but hinge-lock is clearly visible and connects spine segments as designed

s1_differences: No material difference from sketch: same twin spine, loop handle with lever and cable, mid hinge lock, toe with strapped box, tri-star on nosing with toe casters, plus folded slab view as specified. Only perspective occlusion of one star wheel and cable routing.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed: tri-star hub bears on lower nosing, toe casters bear on upper treads without interference, spine-to-toe/star bracket carries load, brake cable runs clear of mid-hinge, loop handle and hinge lever remain reachable.
notes: Callouts verified: Loop Handles, Twin Spine Tubes, Fold Hinge Lock, Brake Band Pawl, Tri Star Wheels, Harness Strap, Toe Plate all correctly spelled, no numbers, leaders end on correct parts. No extra text, numbers, scale bars. Photorealistic render, not diagram/cartoon/wireframe. Folded slab on left is required second view per figure_spec.
